input.message:
Went through every issue in the LLC project and left my call on each one. Here's what I'd do:

*What the LLC takes* (if Sunset can't sell it)
• *Combo Fighter*: comes over through Sunset's sale. I'll pull the CF concept art out of layer.ai before it lapses Mar 3
• *Domino Delights*: it comes over too. It made $183.11 in January (warehouse revenue table) and Blake has its prod account down to $140/mo, so it covers its own hosting. It brings its prod account and player support. Heads up: Apple rejected the DD build on the 13th because the only support option is an email draft. Blake needs to add a support URL before Feb 28
• *Zombie Match* stays with HG: $0 in January
• Everything else stays with HG as we decided in #winddown, or is already cancelled. That includes Calm Play, since per the ground rules the LLC is the new one you and Blake are setting up

*What it costs a month, March–May: $3,450*
• Meta VO campaign: $3,000 (LLC). I added it to the project as ENG-2475 since it wasn't there
• DD prod AWS: $140 (LLC)
• CF backend + auth AWS: $62 (LLC)
• Metabase $100 + dbt $100 + GitHub $48 = $248, which Blake already pays on his card
• AppsFlyer free tier: $0

*Each of us, per month: $1,150*
• Me: $1,150 cash
• You: $1,150 cash
• Blake: $902 cash (+ the $248 he already pays)

Without the Meta campaign it'd be $150 each. That's the real decision for Monday.

Sheet (shared with you and Blake): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1bc829Hd0fkeOMRd7Cz96MLJlyQurPesR7n536iyapGQ/edit
